unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The extractor follows caller-supplied raw/appraisal fields into fail-closed digest-format validation and canonical JSON-to-SHA-256 integrity construction, then conservatively collides the generic sha256 symbol with an unrelated legacy restore helper that performs path.open/fh.read. The appraised-survival module imports no path or file-read surface and never invokes that helper. These calls only validate or construct immutable detached trace digests; they do not acquire external raw text, ingest raw social feedback, poll hardware, emit expression, install runtime capture, or grant a read capability.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: Fail-closed digest rejection and local integrity hashing are audit-visible validation only. They grant no runtime read, hardware polling, raw-social ingestion, persistence, expression, observation-window, cutover, or M3-E authority.
